text: In November 2018, on the seventh, we converged. Thirty-three of us said "general jeff sessions" that day; thirty-two said "attorney general jeff sessions," first put on the record by Donald Norcross back on 2017-01-04. Twenty-one of us reached for "of attorney general," a phrase Ted Cruz sent into the record first, on 2013-02-08. Nineteen said "of attorney general jeff sessions"; nineteen said "acting attorney general." Seventeen of us named "the special counsel," and sixteen named "the mueller investigation," first said by Raja Krishnamoorthi on 2017-09-19. Thirteen of us asked that he "recuse himself from," language Tammy Baldwin first used on 2017-01-04. We record that our peak fell on a single day, 2018-11-07, and that the words we shared that day pointed in one direction. We noted it then. We note it now.
